items.exampleEn: I completely forgot about the meeting.
There were about a dozen people at the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 會議大約有十二個人參加。

items.exampleEn: My new puppy weighs only three pounds.
items.exampleZh: 我的新小狗只有三磅重。

items.exampleEn: The new phone is highly popular with teenagers.
items.exampleZh: 這款新手機在青少年之間非常受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: The price is slightly higher than last year.
items.exampleZh: 價格比去年稍微高一點。

items.exampleEn: Online shopping is increasingly popular among older people.
items.exampleZh: 網路購物在年長者之間越來越受歡迎。

items.sentenceEn: The rent here is relatively cheap for a big city.
items.sentenceZh: 以大城市來說，這裡的房租相對便宜。

items.audioEn: We need two dozen cups for the party, so please buy twenty-four.
items.audioZh: 派對需要兩打杯子，所以請買二十四個。

items.sentenceEn: She is a highly respected cook in our town.
items.sentenceZh: 她是我們鎮上很受敬重的廚師。

items.sentenceEn: Our kitchen is tiny, but it has everything we need.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的廚房很小，但需要的東西都有。

items.stemEn: The water is only ____ warm, so you might feel a bit cold.
items.stemZh: 水只是稍微溫溫的，所以你可能會覺得有點冷。

items.stemEn: This bag of rice weighs five ____.

items.passageEn: Every Saturday, Mrs. Chen sells eggs and vegetables at the market. Her eggs are relatively cheap: a dozen costs only three dollars. Her tomatoes are slightly more expensive this month because of the rain, at two dollars a pound. Her vegetables are highly recommended by local cooks because they are so fresh; she picks them early in the morning. Some of her tomatoes are tiny, but they taste very sweet. Her small stand has become increasingly busy this year.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六，陳太太都在市場賣蛋和蔬菜。她的蛋相對便宜：一打只要三美元。因為下雨，她的番茄這個月稍微貴一點，一磅兩美元。當地的廚師都很推薦她的蔬菜，因為非常新鮮——她一大早才去採。她有些番茄很小，但吃起來很甜。今年她的小攤子越來越忙了。

questions.questionZh: 她的蔬菜為什麼很受歡迎？

items.promptZh: 搬家之後，我的生活變得完全不一樣。
referenceEn: My life became completely different after I moved.
After I moved, my life was completely different.
rubricZh: 用 completely 表示「完全」（例如 completely different；寫 totally 也正確）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 became、has become … since I moved 等）

items.promptZh: 這份工作變得越來越困難。
referenceEn: This job is becoming increasingly difficult.
The job is getting increasingly hard.
rubricZh: 用 increasingly 表示「越來越」（例如 increasingly difficult；寫 harder and harder 也正確）
「變得」可寫，例如 is becoming、is getting 等
